decisions.rule: Record 233M XRP as unchanged only at Elliptic's approximately 04:30 UTC snapshot. Require fresh raw XRPL account_info and transaction history before describing current receiver state.
decisions.rationale: Elliptic's 05:00 update is a dated on-chain intelligence snapshot, not a live account-state read at 10:45 UTC.

decisions.rule: Keep CoinDesk's Binance14 Ethereum reserve crosswalk separate from the five XRPL source wallets. Do not infer XRP PoR membership or undercollateralization from an ETH wallet.
decisions.rationale: CoinDesk identifies Binance14 as an Ethereum hot wallet in October 1 PoR; no XRPL wallet crosswalk was published.

decisions.rule: Mark the 07:33 UTC initial snapshot target elapsed but unverified. Preserve Binance's November 2 result deadline and CoinDesk's November 1 snapshot report as distinct schedule statements.
decisions.rationale: Actual snapshot timestamp and public results have not been located.

decisions.rule: Represent CCTP as a public protocol used in an attacker flow, not as Circle participation, knowledge or consent.
decisions.rationale: Elliptic reports AVAX-to-USDC conversion, CCTP bridge to Ethereum and ETH swap; no evidence Circle knowingly assisted.

decisions.rule: Track the 59.9M USDT collateral and 19,762 ETH borrowing as a separate attacker DeFi position; do not classify Aave's market freeze as seizure or assume liquidation occurred.
decisions.rationale: Elliptic reports the position remained open and near liquidation; market freeze blocked new activity.

decisions.rule: Resolve a fixed-horizon outcome using the latest price observation at or before target_end, reject observations before issuance or after target_end, require outcome_recorded_at no earlier than target_end, and record effective horizon and observation lag.
decisions.rationale: The prior implementation allowed up to 15 minutes of post-horizon price data, creating variable-horizon label contamination. PR1406 corrects this on a fresh-main draft branch and passes exact-head CI.

decisions.rule: Keep scheduler write/dispatch capability on main classified as active risk. PR1407 proposes scheduled read-only queue audit; task execution should remain paused until a durable state store and explicit dispatch allowlist exist.
decisions.rationale: Current workflow has contents:write/actions:write and dispatches any existing workflow file; current queue has no pending entries. Proposal is draft/unmerged.

decisions.rule: Do not treat PR1404, PR1405 or PR1407 as production fixes until approved and merged. Preserve main and retain tradeoffs for review.
decisions.rationale: All exact-head CI and fail-closed gates passed, but each PR is draft and unmerged.

decisions.rule: Do not issue a directional XRP probability until fixed-horizon data, feature ingestion, walk-forward baselines and calibration are executed and verified.
decisions.rationale: PR1406 is a ledger contract only; no model training, walk-forward evaluation, calibration, drift detection or shadow evaluation exists.
